notes: BTL form 1500 (unemployment claim, 05.2026 edition), supplied by Shlomi on 2026-10-08 as T1500.pdf; PDF page 5 of 7, printed 'עמוד 4 מתוך 6' (pageIndex 4): section 8 (business and income during the unemployment period), section 9 (law and accounting exams), the section 10 notice and the section 11 declaration with date and signature. Flat Word export with a text layer, no AcroForm. Conventions copied from btl-bl211-2015-page7: an underscore run is a text target one text height (11 pt) above the printed line, x from the first to the last underscore; a date on a blank underline is a `date` with no cells; a checkbox is the ink of the printed square (Wingdings glyph, drop shadow included); yes/no pairs are two independent checkboxes; a signature is a `signature` target about 17 pt tall above its line; labels are the field's own caption, followed by ' / ' and its group or question. Pattern not covered by earlier truths: a date with no printed line (the blank after 'כן, בתאריך', t013), bounded to the empty space left of its caption. Not annotated: the section badges 8-11, the grey section bars, the pre-printed ✖ marks beside the signatures, the underline of the www.btl.gov.il link, a run of 26 underscores at x 408-552 pt, y 199 pt that is in the text layer but not painted (nothing is visible), all declaration and notice text, and the footer. Checkbox bounds are the printed square without the shadow (FORM-31 convention).
